symptom: `describe page` printed a gallery whose Database source runs over an association as `gallery g1 (DataSource: $currentObject/Probe.Item_Parent, …)` — no `sort by`, no `where`, although the stored CustomWidgets$CustomWidgetXPathSource carries a GridSortBar; and `create page` refused the faithful spelling with "`database from $currentObject/…` is a LIST VIEW source reached over an association, and gallery cannot store one"
cause: parseDataSource sent an XPath source with an IndirectEntityRef to parseEntityPathSource only for Forms$ListViewXPathSource (#721 L5); the pluggable CustomWidgetXPathSource fell to parseContextSource (the #941 reading), which yields an association source and drops XPath and sort — and replays as a Forms$AssociationSource, a different retrieve. On the write side checkDatabaseOverAssociationIsOnAListView refused the form for every non-list-view widget on 10+, and customWidgetDataSourceToGen wrote only a DirectEntityRef
file: `mdl/executor/cmd_pages_describe_datasource.go` (parseDataSource), `mdl/executor/pluggable_database_source.go` (buildPluggableDataSourceV3), `mdl/executor/cmd_pages_builder_v3.go` (check removed; buildDataSourceV3 refusal reworded), `mdl/backend/modelsdk/widget_write.go` (customWidgetDataSourceToGen: IndirectEntityRef + SourceVariable)
insight: The 9.x fix for the same shape (#1399) already had the whole write path — buildDatabaseOverAssociationV3 and the version gate — so the 10+ case was a one-branch change once the reader stopped treating the XPath source as an association; check which source TYPE a reading replays to, not just whether the text parses. The #941 association reading was itself lossy (type change on replay) and only looked faithful because a source with no sort replays to the same rows. Measured on 11.12.1: the reporter's shape authored directly in MDL, mx check 0 errors, describe -> exec `Unchanged page`; control with the association name byte-patched to a nonexistent one -> CE1613 at Gallery 'g1', so mx check does read the path. A hop with no stored destination keeps the association reading
